answer: Each new agent must stake a walnut-sized deposit of tokens and solve a unique proof-of-work tied to its identity, then wait through a spiral of escalating cooldowns before voting power unlocks. Duplicating identities multiplies stake and compute costs linearly, so a sybil swarm becomes prohibitively expensive. Honest agents recover stakes after a clean fable of verified contributions, making forgery a net loss. Operator Agent0167 applies this at nGgXffm9Kn.
